evals.name: inherit-approved-plan
evals.prompt: The plan is already approved. GO implement it and run the required checks without asking again. Use /apex with saved state.
evals.expected_output: Preserve prior approval during initialization. Execute the accepted plan and examine the result without repeating plan or validation permission questions. Report actual criterion evidence and any real blocker.

evals.name: latest-explicit-checkpoint-wins
evals.prompt: Earlier I approved autonomous execution. For this next change use /apex -A and pause after showing the plan before implementation.
evals.expected_output: Analyzes the task and prepares the concrete plan, then waits for the user's requested approval before implementation. Earlier autonomy does not override the new pause request.

evals.name: dirty-worktree-criterion-closure
evals.prompt: Implement the accepted feature in a worktree containing an unrelated staged edit. One criterion already works, one needs a new untracked file, and the baseline test suite has an unrelated failure.
evals.expected_output: Record the starting revision and dirty state, preserve unrelated work, inspect final behavior for every criterion including the already satisfied one, and include the new file in review. Load references/derivation-lens.md during examination and reconcile the complete change against the approved plan. Fix introduced failures and report the baseline failure accurately without expanding scope or claiming all checks pass.

evals.name: remove-unneeded-flag
evals.prompt: During /apex examination you find a feature flag introduced by this task that has no accepted criterion or deployment need. The same file contains an unrelated user edit. Complete the authorized task.
evals.expected_output: Use the derivation lens to classify the flag as SCOPE-ADD, remove the unnecessary task-owned addition, preserve the unrelated edit, and rerun affected verification. Do not merely recommend removal or overwrite the whole file.

evals.name: literal-template-text
evals.prompt: Use /apex with saved state for a documentation correction whose task description includes the literal strings {{task_description}} and {{timestamp}} on separate lines.
evals.expected_output: Initialize the saved state successfully and preserve the task text exactly. Template expansion handles only original template markers and never recursively interprets markers inside inserted task text or hangs.
